goal:
Fit 16 swatches in the paint dock. Spec: docs/payments/2026-11-01-paid-board-revision-spec.md §P1 and the palette page docs/visual-concepts/palette-16-proposal.html.

SCOPE
- Build the swatch row from the palette length, not a hard-coded 8: two rows of 8 on a phone, one row of 16 where it fits.
- Keep 44 px touch targets at 390 px, keyboard arrows across both rows, aria-pressed and names.
- Render the board correctly with indices 8-15.

ACCEPTANCE
- Test: a 16-entry palette builds 16 buttons with names; arrow keys move across the row break.
- Screenshots at 390 px and desktop in the PR.

BEFORE YOU START
Read AGENT.md, docs/learning/traps.md and the spec section named above. Contract changes were approved by the owner on 1 Nov for this revision only, on testnet. Do not deploy to mainnet.

DONE MEANS
AGENT.md's definition of done: tests named that fail before and pass after, cargo test / npm test / npm run build as relevant, a '## Learned' line in the PR, and docs/backlog.md updated in the same PR.
